reviews.review_title: A BRILLIANT TWIST ON PUZZLE GAMES
reviews.review_description:
Plonk! A 4D Puzzle takes a familiar concept and transforms it into something genuinely fresh. The time manipulation mechanic is clever, intuitive, and creates satisfying "aha" moments throughout the experience.

The claymation-inspired visuals are charming, the mixed reality integration feels natural, and the puzzles remain engaging from start to finish. A fantastic showcase of creative design on Meta Quest.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much, we appreciate your review for Plonk!
